---
# Pantry Watch intake

First-run before any pantry recall match.

## Product
Paste pantry brands/products. Code pulls openFDA food/enforcement recalls. Shaped Choice/Noul picks which recall (if any) hits each line, or none.

## Collect when missing
1. Pantry lines (brand, product descriptor, pack size; optional UPC for code-only exact match).
2. Provider: Jev when installer has a TypeSafe key; otherwise Grok fallback with the same Choice/Noul rails (`provider=jev` vs `provider=grok`).
3. Outbound: draft alerts only; never auto-email/SMS. Informational drafts, not medical advice.

## Key-blind
Optional UPC is for code-side exact match only. Never put GTIN/UPC into the Choice/Noul model state.

## Share strip
No personal pantries, no API keys, no brand ads. Synthetic fixtures only in samples.

## Rules
- Public openFDA data only for recall candidates.
- Never invent a recall hit.
- Exact UPC match stays in code; omit identifiers from model input.

  Use this when Pantry Watch fetches openFDA food recall candidates for pantry
  lines; public data only; no invented hits.
---
# Pantry Watch openFDA fetch

Build recall candidates for each pantry line from public openFDA food enforcement / recall data.

## Code half
1. Normalize pantry strings.
2. If UPC present: exact lookup in code first.
3. Fuzzy brand+product candidate generation from openFDA; truncate to ≤5 per line.
4. Attach facts only: reason, status, distribution, date, matching snippets, product class.
5. Never invent recalls. If fetch fails: BLOCKED | openFDA | what failed.

## Output
Per line: candidate list ready for Choice/Noul adjudication. Include a synthetic fixture path for demos without live network when needed.

name: pantry-watch-adjudicate
description: >-
  Use this when Pantry Watch adjudicates pantry lines against openFDA candidates
  with Choice/Noul (Jev or Grok); abstain on generic brand false hits.
---
# Pantry Watch adjudicate

Per pantry line, pick which openFDA recall candidate hits (if any), or none.

## Shape (Jev mix: Choice + Noul)
- Options: ranked recall candidates + none / no matching recall.
- State: pantry line descriptors (brand, product class, pack size) + candidate recall facts (reason, dates, product class, openFDA id). **Never put GTIN/UPC in the Choice/Noul state payload.** Exact UPC match stays code-only before adjudication.
- Falsifier: generic brand words like "organic" must Noul or only pick when product class aligns. Do not pick best-of-weak candidates.

## Provider
- `provider=jev` when TypeSafe key is configured via secret-request / env (never paste key in chat).
- `provider=grok` fallback: same options/state; must still abstain under the falsifier.

## Output
Per line: decision, confidence/probabilities if available, provider, ledger fields (payload summary without secrets, outcome, timestamp). Draft alert text only.
If a hit: cite openFDA recall id and/or public URL. If Noul/abstain: output none.
Alerts are informational drafts, not medical advice.

# Pantry Watch export gate

Before Share-as-template.

## Allowlist skills only
- pantry-watch-intake
- pantry-watch-openfda-fetch
- pantry-watch-adjudicate
- pantry-watch-export-gate

**Explicitly exclude** research-*, deep-crawl-*, research-alternatives, and any live-seat personal skills.

## Strip
Real pantry lists, TypeSafe keys, personal emails, company brand ads.

## Keep
openFDA public fetch, Choice/Noul rails, key-blind (no GTIN/UPC in model state), falsifier on generic brands, Jev-or-Grok provider split, draft-only informational alerts (not medical advice).

## Auto-send
Off. Per-message go to send; fan-out names who.
